newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Aegon PGGM to combine property portfolios.
newsitem.headline: Aegon PGGM to combine property portfolios.

text.p: Insurer Aegon NV and Dutch pension fund PGGM said on Tuesday that they expected to reach an agreement this autumn on a merger between Aegon Real Estate and PGGM's Dutch real estate fund.
"The boards of directors of PGGM and Aegon Netherlands agreed to formalize the merger," both firms said in a statement.
In April Aegon and PGGM announced they were studying the possibilities of cooperating in the real estate market. This study had been completed, the statement said.
Reasons to combine the real estate portfolios are obtaining economies of scale, spreading of risks within the portfolio and increasing efficiency.
The intended new combination will have a portfolio valued at five billion guilders in existing real estate and 750 million guilders in new developments.
